facts.text: The resort sits where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez, on the southern tip of Mexico's Baja California Peninsula.
facts.excerpt: Relaxation and renewal await where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez on the southern tip of Mexico’s Baja California Peninsula.

facts.text: Guests enter the resort through the private Dos Mares tunnel.
facts.excerpt: Enter paradise through the private Dos Mares tunnel

facts.text: The resort covers 24 acres and is carved into the mountain.
facts.excerpt: our 24-acre, Forbes Five-Star resort and spa carved into the mountain near the pristine Los Cabos beach

facts.text: Every accommodation has its own private plunge pool and Pacific Ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Every accommodation features its own private plunge pool and Pacific Ocean views.

facts.text: Guests are welcomed in their room with a bottle of premium tequila as a gift.
facts.excerpt: a bottle of Premium Tequila, our gift to you, will welcome you in your room

facts.text: Stays come with bespoke service from the resort's butlers and Personal Concierge team.
facts.excerpt: bespoke service by our Butlers and Personal Concierge team

facts.text: At El Farallon, overlooking the Pacific, the local fishermen's catch is prepared in an open-air kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Pacific Ocean, listen to the waves crash below and select from an ocean-to-table menu, where the best of the local fishermen’s catch is prepared by Executive Chef Gustavo Pinet in an open air kitchen

facts.text: El Farallon's Champagne Terrace offers a curated collection of 20 rotating champagnes.
facts.excerpt: Explore a curated collection of 20 unique, rotating champagnes on the restaurant’s Champagne Terrace

facts.text: Don Manuel's serves casual breakfast and lunch and turns into fine dining in the evening, with live local musicians.
facts.excerpt: Casual daytime dining transitions a gourmet fine dining experience in the evening as warm lighting and live local musicians set the scene

facts.text: The Agave Study at Peacock Alley offers tastings of agave spirits, from tequila in Jalisco to mezcal in Oaxaca.
facts.excerpt: Explore agave spirits from tequila in Jalisco to mezcal in Oaxaca, and every plant in the lands between.

facts.text: Mar y Lena is the resort's signature steakhouse, with wood-fired cooking at The Beach Club Palapa.
facts.excerpt: Mar y Leña is our signature steakhouse— an intimate culinary journey that blends wood-fired cooking, premium cuts, and the unmistakable essence of the ocean.

facts.text: Travesia at Su Cocina is an experience centered on the taco.
facts.excerpt: At Travesía, we’ve curated a unique experience centered around the beloved taco.

facts.text: The spa's wet-area grottos have steam rooms, saunas, ice rooms and whirlpools.
facts.excerpt: Wet area grottos feature steam rooms, saunas, ice rooms, and whirlpools, with local herbal remedies to help you achieve your deepest relaxation.

facts.text: A saltwater meditation pool is reached directly from the spa's private treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: Complete your spa journey with a cleansing dip in the saltwater meditation pool, directly accessed from your private treatment room.

facts.text: Spa treatments draw on the moon, the sea and Mexican folk healing.
facts.excerpt: Tap into the healing culture of Baja with experiences inspired by the moon, the sea and Mexican folk healing.

facts.text: The Intention treatment was developed with local curanderos and shamans and includes an energy cleansing ritual, craniosacral therapy and a Mexican folk massage.
facts.excerpt: Developed alongside local curanderos and shamans, the Intention includes an energy cleansing ritual, craniosacral therapy, and a Mexican folk massage.

facts.text: The resort has two beachfront infinity pools, a saltwater relaxation pool and a zero-edge kids' pool.
facts.excerpt: Relax in two beachfront infinity pools, a saltwater relaxation pool, and a zero-edge kids’ pool.

facts.text: Complimentary yoga classes are offered, and there are two tennis courts with a tennis pro.
facts.excerpt: Start your day with complimentary yoga classes, reserve time with one of our fitness instructors, or let our tennis pro assist in brushing up your game on one of two tennis courts.

facts.text: From December to April, small-group whale watching trips follow the whales' annual migration.
facts.excerpt: From December to April, ride a high-speed boat with a small group and watch the whales' annual migration.

facts.text: Excursions include Panga reef cruises, surfing lessons, breakfast on the resort's private yacht and farm-to-table lunches in Todos Santos.
facts.excerpt: Choose adventures from Panga reef cruises and surfing lessons to breakfast on our private yacht and farm-to-table lunches in Todos Santos.

facts.text: Tortugitas Kids Club offers half-day, full-day and evening programming, including scavenger hunts, sandcastle building and language and cultural immersion.
facts.excerpt: Kids can learn and play with half-day, full-day, and evening programming that includes scavenger hunts, sandcastle building, and language and cultural immersion.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says there are no kids' clubs and the property largely caters to adults or families with adult children.
facts.excerpt: There are no kids’ clubs or child-focused amenities beyond standard food options.

facts.text: The property originally opened as Capella Pedregal in 2009.
facts.excerpt: The property originally opened as a Capella Pedregal in 2009

facts.text: Because the resort faces the Pacific, strong waves and a constant undercurrent mean ocean swimming is prohibited.
facts.excerpt: strong waves and a constant undercurrent make ocean swimming prohibited here

facts.text: The resort sits in a residential enclave behind a private mountain tunnel, with very little within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: it offers absolute seclusion, but very little within walking distance

facts.text: The redesign uses custom furniture, textiles and decorative pieces from artisans in Oaxaca, Baja California Sur and Jalisco.
facts.excerpt: The redesign leans heavily into Mexican craftsmanship and features custom furniture, textiles, and decorative pieces sourced from artisans across Oaxaca, Baja California Sur, and Jalisco.

facts.text: Rooms have in-room fireplaces for cooler nights.
facts.excerpt: Expect in-room fireplaces for cooler nights

facts.text: Chips and freshly made guacamole are delivered to the room daily.
facts.excerpt: Perhaps one of the coolest hotel amenities is the daily delivery of chips and freshly made guacamole straight to your room.

facts.text: Due to the cliffside location and multi-level design, travelers with limited mobility may encounter challenges.
facts.excerpt: due to the hotel’s cliffside location and multi-level design, travelers with limited mobility may encounter challenges

facts.text: Waldorf Astoria completed a multi-year, property-wide renovation recently.
facts.excerpt: Recently, the Waldorf completed a multi-year, property-wide renovation

contradictions.note: Official experiences page (p5) describes Tortugitas Kids Club; Conde Nast Traveler review (p6) says there are no kids' clubs.
